meta.title: PrimePlot
meta.description: Real estate showcase, CRM and sales management.

design.title: Spaces planned with intention.
design.intro: Every colour, typeface and component PrimePlot is built from. Check here first — then pages follow.
design.bodySample: PrimePlot keeps every unit, lead and installment in one place, so your sales team always knows what is available and what is due.
design.projectBlurb: Fourteen-storey residential tower, south-facing units, two basements, rooftop garden.
design.drawerBody: Drawers hold detail views (lead, unit, booking) without leaving the list.
design.failedMsg: Couldn't save. The unit was just booked by someone else.
design.emptyBody: Leads from your website and Facebook ads will appear here.
design.errorBody: The server didn't respond. Your data is safe.
design.phoneError: Enter a valid Bangladeshi mobile number.
design.agreeHint: T-7, T-0 and T+3 days around each installment.

layout.quote: Every unit, lead and installment — in one quiet place.

rules.weak: This password is too easy to guess, or contains your name or email. Try a longer phrase.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Use the email your administrator registered for you.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.subtitle: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to set a new password.
forgot.sentBody: If an account exists for {email}, a reset link is on its way. It works once and expires in 30 minutes.
forgot.sentHint: Nothing after a few minutes? Check spam, or send it again.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.subtitle: You'll be signed out of every device after this.
reset.invalidBody: It has expired, was already used, or a newer link was sent. Request a new one.

setup.title: Set your password
setup.subtitle: Choose a password to activate your account.
setup.invalidBody: It has expired or was already used. Ask your administrator to send a new invitation.

shell.searchPlaceholder: Go to a page or run a command…
shell.noAccessTitle: You don't have access to this page
shell.noAccessBody: Ask an administrator if you need it for your work.

profile.emailHint: Ask an admin to change your sign-in email.
profile.name: Full name

comingSoon.title: {name} is on the way
comingSoon.phase: This module is built in phase {phase}. The navigation is ready so your team can see what's coming.

overview.intro: Here's where your projects, leads and collections will come together. Start with the steps below.

org.title: Complete your company profile
org.body: Name, address, trade licence and REHAB number appear on receipts and allotment letters.

team.title: Invite your team
team.body: Add sales managers and executives — each gets an email to set a password.

project.title: Add your first project
project.body: Towers, floors and units, or a plot layout with sectors and roads.

leads.title: Connect your lead sources
leads.body: Website forms and Facebook Lead Ads flow straight into the pipeline.

portalHome.intro: Your units, payment schedule, receipts and documents will appear here.
portalHome.emptyBody: Once your booking is recorded, you'll see your unit, dues and receipts on this page.

team.title: Team
team.description: Everyone who can sign in — staff and clients. Roles decide what each person can see and do.
team.emptyBody: Invite your sales team to get started.
team.noMatchesBody: Try a different name, role or status.
team.inviteDescription: They'll get an email to set their password (link valid 72 hours).
team.name: Full name
team.emailHint: They sign in with this address.
team.emailLocked: The sign-in email can't be changed here.
team.statusHint: Disabling signs them out everywhere at once.
team.selfHint: You can't change your own role.

roleHelp.invite: Admin: everything. Sales manager: all leads, inventory edits, bookings, receipts. Sales executive: own leads, holds, bookings. Client: the customer portal only.
roleHelp.edit: Changing the role or status signs this person out on every device immediately.

errors.duplicate: Someone with this email is already on the team.
errors.phone: Enter a valid Bangladeshi mobile number.
errors.SELF_CHANGE: You can't change your own role or status. Ask another admin.
errors.LAST_ADMIN: At least one active admin must remain.
errors.INVITE_PENDING: Invited members activate themselves from the email link.
errors.ALREADY_ACTIVE: This member has already activated their account.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.description: Who did what, and when. Entries can't be edited or deleted and are kept for one year.
audit.emptyBody: Try a wider date range or another area.

settings.title: Company settings
settings.description: Appears on receipts, allotment letters, emails and the public site.

identity.title: Identity
identity.description: Name and logo in both languages.

contact.title: Contact
contact.description: Shown to clients on documents and the website.

legal.title: Registration
legal.description: Printed on money receipts and allotment letters.

preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.description: Defaults for new users and accounting periods.

hints.defaultLocale: For new team members and clients.
hints.fiscalYear: Receipt numbers restart each fiscal year. Bangladesh: July. Change only before the first receipt.

logo.label: Logo
logo.hint: PNG, JPG or WebP, up to 15 MB. A transparent PNG works best.

errors.UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE: Use a PNG, JPG or WebP image (SVG isn't supported).
errors.FILE_TOO_LARGE: The image is too large (max 15 MB).

errors.phone: Enter a valid Bangladeshi mobile number.
errors.website: Enter a full address starting with https://

projects.title: Projects
projects.description: Buildings and plot layouts you sell — their stock, prices and what the website shows.
projects.noMatchesBody: Try another name, type or stage.
projects.emptyBody: Add your first building or plot layout, then generate its units.
projects.createDescription: Start with the basics — everything else can be filled in later.
projects.createNote: The project stays a draft (not on the website) until you publish it from Details.
projects.notFound: This project doesn't exist or was deleted

hints.kind: Can't be changed later — it decides how units are measured and priced.
hints.slugNeeded: Bangla-only name — type an English address, e.g. lake-view.
hints.slugLive: Changing it changes the public link.
hints.coords: From Google Maps: right-click the site → copy the numbers.
hints.land: As written in the deed. Katha and decimal are both kept.
hints.published: Units marked blocked never appear on the site.
hints.publicPricing: Off = "Price on request" on the website.

errors.slug: Use lowercase letters, digits and dashes
errors.slugTaken: Another project already uses this address
errors.latLng: Give both latitude and longitude, or neither
errors.stale: Someone else saved this project meanwhile. Reload to see their changes.
errors.media: That image is no longer available. Upload it again.

sections.identityBody: Name in both languages and the photo used everywhere.
sections.storyBody: Shown on the project page of the website.
sections.locationBody: Area and city power the website filters; coordinates place the map pin.
sections.landBody: Printed on brochures and allotment letters.

cover.hint: JPG, PNG or WebP up to 15 MB. Landscape works best. Until you upload one, a sample photo is shown.

errors.UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE: Only JPG, PNG, WebP or AVIF images.
errors.FILE_TOO_LARGE: The photo is larger than 15 MB.
errors.INVALID_IMAGE: This image looks damaged. Try another file.

inventory.addAt: Add a unit on floor {floor}, position {position}
inventory.groundLineNote: The heavy line is ground level; rows below it are basements.
inventory.noBuildingsBody: Add the building (or towers) first — units sit on its floors.
inventory.noBlocksBody: Add a block or sector — plots are grouped under it.
inventory.noUnitsBody: Generate floors × positions in one go, or set the floor range to add units one by one.
inventory.noPlotsBody: Generate a numbered run of plots along a road.

errors.STALE_VERSION: Someone changed this unit meanwhile (or it was put on hold). Close and open it again.
errors.UNIT_LOCKED: This unit is sold — its size and price can't change.
errors.UNIT_STATE_CONFLICT: Someone else just changed this unit. Showing its current state.
errors.HOLD_LIMIT: You already hold {limit} units. Release one first.
errors.NOT_HOLDER: Only the person holding this unit or a manager can release it.
errors.UNIT_IN_USE: Only available or blocked units can be deleted.

form.positionInvalid: Letters and digits only, e.g. A or B2
form.moneyInvalid: Amount in taka, up to 2 decimals
form.plotNoOrCode: Give a plot number or a code
form.positionOrCode: Give a position or a code
form.codeTaken: Another unit of this project has this code
form.floorOutOfRange: This floor is outside the building's floor range
form.codeOrFields: Give a code, or floor + position
form.soldNote: This unit is sold: size, location and price are locked (the booking keeps its own copy).
form.codeHint: Leave empty for building-floor-position, e.g. A-5B.
form.codeHintPlot: Leave empty for block-plot, e.g. B-12.
form.landHint: As in the deed — katha or decimal. The other unit is worked out for you.
form.rateOverrideHint: Replaces the rate card's base rate for this unit only.

price.onRequest: Price on request — set the project's rate card to price this unit.

actions.soldInfo: Booked. Allotment, registration and cancellation are done from Bookings.
actions.heldOk: Unit is on hold for you.
actions.noteHint: Who is it for? e.g. "Mr. Karim, site visit Friday"
actions.blockedOk: Unit blocked — it's hidden from the website.

blocks.floorOrder: Must be at or above the lowest floor
blocks.codeTaken: This code is already used in the project
blocks.unitsOutside: {n} units are on floors outside this range. Move them first.
blocks.stale: Someone else changed this meanwhile. Close and try again.
blocks.name: Name (English)
blocks.inUse: Move or delete its units first.

bulk.title: Generate units — {block}
bulk.description: Create a whole run in one go. Prices come from the rate card automatically.
bulk.positionsHint: Separated by commas, e.g. A, B, C, D
bulk.positionsInvalid: Letters/digits only, e.g. A, B, C
bulk.templateInvalid: Check the template: whole rooms, area with up to 2 decimals.
bulk.skipExisting: Skip slots that already have a unit
bulk.landHint: Same for every plot; edit odd ones afterwards.
bulk.skipExistingPlots: Skip plot numbers that already exist
bulk.duplicate: Some of these codes already exist. Tick "skip" or change the range.
bulk.tooMany: At most {max} at a time — split the range.
bulk.note: Nothing is saved unless every unit can be created. You can edit any unit afterwards.

index.title: Live inventory
index.description: Pick a project to open its live unit grid.

pricing.baseBody: Per square foot of saleable area.
pricing.baseBodyPlot: Per katha or per decimal — the plot's deed unit is converted exactly.
pricing.floorRiseBody: Higher floors cost more: each floor from the start floor up adds this much per sft.
pricing.fromFloorHint: e.g. 3 → floor 3 adds 1 step, floor 5 adds 3
pricing.roadWidthBody: Plots on wider roads cost more. The widest tier a plot qualifies for applies.
pricing.facingBody: Extra per sft by direction. South-facing usually costs more.
pricing.negativeHint: Use a minus amount for a discount on less popular directions.
pricing.cornerBody: Corner units and each parking slot.
pricing.cornerBodyPlot: Corner plots pay a percentage of their base price.
pricing.chargesBody: Added to every unit: utility connection, generator, association fund…
pricing.readOnly: Only an administrator can change prices. You're viewing the current rate card.
pricing.saved: Rate card saved · {n, plural, =0 {no unit prices changed} one {# unit re-priced} other {# units re-priced}}.
pricing.unsaved: Unsaved changes — saving re-prices every unsold unit
pricing.never: Not set yet — units show "price on request"

errors.money: Amount in taka, up to 2 decimals
errors.label: Required
errors.floorRisePair: Give both the start floor and the amount, or neither
